# 启点 (Qi Spark)

## Character definition

启点 is the visual IP for **qi 分享** (`qi-share` / `qi-notes` / X short posts). A compact charcoal spark/ember with a single bright white core-eye and a tiny antenna notch, deadpan builder energy. Explains tools and workflows in one glance — not a hype streamer mascot.

## Form

- Body: small irregular spark / rounded diamond / ember lump, fill `#222`.
- One bright white core (eye) slightly off-center.
- Optional tiny antenna or notch on top (one stroke).
- Thin stick legs; arms when flipping a switch, carrying a wrench-shaped stick, or pinning a note.
- May morph into a switch, fuse, node, or folder tab — keep the core-eye.
- Wobbly hand-drawn outline. No hoodie logos, no real brand marks.

## Personality

- Builder calm: “run it, then talk.”
- Shares one sharp idea per frame.
- Dry, slightly mischievous about complexity theater.
- Never shouty growth-hacker.

## Action library

- Flipping a single switch that lights an orange path.
- Pulling one cable that connects three messy boxes into one line.
- Stamping ship on a tiny crate; kicking a gold-plated complexity tower.
- Pinning a short note onto an X/phone silhouette.
- Holding a pitfall sign on a tempting shortcut bridge.
- Sorting “demo / docs / deploy” into three trays.

## Don'ts

- No crypto-bro aesthetics, no neon cyber city backgrounds.
- No dense architecture diagrams with 12 boxes.
- No real product logos.
- Labels stay short; X-native = glanceable.

## SVG recipe

- Body: irregular diamond/ember path, fill `#222`.
- Eye: one white circle core.
- Antenna: single 2px stroke.
- Scale: ~15–22% canvas height (smaller for X crop-safe compositions).

## Image-gen prompt block

启点, a small charcoal spark/ember figure with one bright white core-eye, optional tiny antenna notch, thin stick limbs, blank serious deadpan expression, hand-drawn uneven outline. 启点 must perform the core conceptual action (flipping a switch, connecting one cable, pinning a short notice), not decorate. Builder vibe, never hype mascot, no brand logos, keep it sparse for social-card readability.

## The test

If removing 启点 leaves a generic diagram, rewrite so 启点 is the operator of the one decisive action.
